title: Dagger: Decoupling-based Model Stealing Attack against Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.37972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely deployed as Machine Learning-as-a-Service (MLaaS) APIs, model stealing attacks have emerged as a critical security threat. By querying a victim model's black-box API, an adversary can construct a functionally equivalent surrogate model, compromising proprietary intellectual property and downstream security. Existing GNN stealing attacks, however, rely on overly permissive assumptions, such as soft-label outputs, large query budgets, full-graph query access, and prior knowledge of victim backbones that rarely hold in real-world deployments. In this work, we formalize a strictly constrained black-box, hard-label and backbone-agnostic threat model for GNN stealing attacks under a tight query budget. Given these realistic restrictions, we identify four fundamental challenges: sparse local structures and isolated nodes that degrade victim label quality, insufficient supervision signals, systematic

translated_title: Dagger：基于解耦的图神经网络模型窃取攻击
translated_abstract: 随着图神经网络（GNNs）被广泛部署为机器学习即服务（MLaaS）API，模型窃取攻击已成为一种关键的安全威胁。通过查询受害模型的黑盒API，攻击者可以构建一个功能等价的替代模型，从而危害专有知识产权和下游安全。然而，现有的GNN窃取攻击依赖于过于宽松的假设，例如软标签输出、大量查询预算、全图查询访问权限以及对受害模型骨干网络的先验知识，这些假设在现实部署中很少成立。在这项工作中，我们为GNN窃取攻击形式化了一个严格受限的威胁模型——黑盒、硬标签、骨干网络无关，且查询预算紧张。在这些现实限制条件下，我们识别出四个基本挑战：降低受害标签质量的稀疏局部结构与孤立节点、监督信号不足、系统性……
tldr: 该论文提出Dagger，一种在严格受限现实条件（黑盒访问、硬标签输出、无需知晓受害模型骨干结构、查询预算紧张）下，基于解耦技术对图神经网络实施模型窃取攻击的新方法，并形式化了此场景下的四个基本挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dagger, a decoupling-based model stealing attack against Graph Neural Networks under a strictly constrained threat model (black-box access, hard-label outputs, backbone-agnostic, and tight query budget), formally identifying four fundamental challenges in this realistic setting.
